verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Cost as a first-party metric on logged traces that can be aggregated over a time window. It captures every session, trace and span, which implies per-request cost data exists in the product. However, the evidence shows cost only in the context of alerts, not dashboards, and token usage and per-model breakdowns are never mentioned. missing for 10: documented cost/token dashboards, token usage tracking, per-model breakdown, per-request cost view, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour
Your cost is higher than expected
Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.
